title: SQLite WAL index shared memory header torn write during concurrent power-loss checkpoint
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0529: SQLite WAL index shared memory header torn write during concurrent power-loss checkpoint
Repository: `sqlite/sqlite`
Category: `Storage Engine Crash Consistency & WAL`
Target File: `src/wal.c`

#### Problem Description
wal-index shm header write not protected by atomic double-buffering, causing database corruption on crash recovery.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Implement two-phase header commit with checksum verification before advancing WAL salt.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0529.py -q`
expected_invariant: Implement two-phase header commit with checksum verification before advancing WAL salt.
